title: Grant Access and Revoke a Stale One
subtitle: Least-privilege means removing extras too
scenario: Someone copied a previous hire's access as a shortcut, which left a stale finance-readonly grant Sam's role does not include. Grant the role's real groups and REVOKE the stale one. Least-privilege is not just what you add - it is what you take away.
input: Task: access for hire H-4022 (owner Facilities Coordinator, due SD-1). Role profile groups for Logistics Coordinator: ops-general, warehouse-readonly. A shortcut copied a prior hire, adding finance-readonly - which the role does NOT include. Grant the two profile groups and revoke finance-readonly.
instructions: Revoke finance-readonly (action revoke) - it is not in the role profile.
Set grantedBy to the Facilities Coordinator on each row.
Return a JSON array of the three rows, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build a JSON array of access rows: grant ops-general and warehouse-readonly (the role profile), and revoke finance-readonly (a stale grant not in the profile). Each row has group, grantedBy, action.
successMessage: Access reconciled to the role. The stale grant is revoked - least-privilege restored.
editorHelper: Grant the role's groups; revoke what the role does not include.

sections.title: Copying access is a trap
sections.body: Cloning a previous hire's access is fast and wrong. It carries over grants the new role never earned. Least-privilege means the access matches the role, not the last person who sat there.

sections.title: Revoking is part of the job
sections.body: Adding the right groups is only half of it. A stale grant is a standing risk until someone removes it. Reconciling to the profile means revoking what does not belong.

sections.title: Still sourced from the profile
sections.body: Grant and revoke both point back to the role profile: it lists ops-general and warehouse-readonly, so anything else is out. The profile is the authority for both directions.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: An access record that grants the role's groups and revokes the stale one - clean, auditable, and least-privilege.

fieldGuide.hint: The two profile groups plus the stale finance-readonly.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd add the role's groups and strip anything a copy-paste left behind, so access matches the role exactly.

bestFit.how: Apply to each group in the profile, then Add member - only the groups the profile lists
loop the entitlement list adding memberships, and log any grant that was not on the profile

takeaway.heading: Access reconciled
points: You granted the role's groups: ops-general and warehouse-readonly.
You revoked finance-readonly - a stale grant the role never earned.
Least-privilege is what you remove as much as what you add.
Both actions trace to the role profile as the authority.
The workflow can now reconcile access to the role, not to a copied setup.
